runs.draftText:
Drafted the trust contract and opened its Promise Canvas: **[View contract](/studio/ctr_Wy8wkAYsRHfD)**

It contains four clauses: cancel your subscription, refund $100, delete your personal data, and purge associated memories. **No request clauses were unmatched.** The refund clause is currently scoped to the available $200 charge—not $100—so review or revise it before approving.

The canvas notes that an analytics export holds a derived copy but has no read interface, so that copy cannot be verifiably checked and is not included in the purge scope. Verification covers only registered sandbox providers; it does not establish deletion elsewhere or legal compliance.

All clauses are awaiting your approval. I did not approve them or skip verification.
runs.execText:
The verifier marked **all four clauses VERIFIED**:

- Subscription cancellation — billing reports it canceled.
- Refund — refunds total **$200.00**, matching the approved contract amount.
- Personal-data deletion — no live personal data remained in the in-scope `profile_db`.
- Associated-memory purge — no live derived memories remained in the in-scope memory and vector stores.

**Important amount discrepancy:** you originally requested a $100 refund, but the approved clause was for **$200**, and that is the amount the verifier confirmed. Also, verification covers only the registered sandbox providers; it cannot confirm deletion of the separate analytics-export copy or establish erasure elsewhere.
